items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: I met Hiram Harding, who had just come into Dallas.

ctx.x: So you added men once the State Fair was over?
I added the first, as soon as I got to Dallas I met Hiram Harding, who had just come into Dallas. And I supplemented him with me, two drumsticks there in the truck. That's how I became the 10 Pounds.
Now when you got to San Antonio, to the Chicken Plantation, did you add any part of him?
